description.value: Owl Pub is a full-service pub in Osoyoos boasting 18 rotating draft taps and a menu of pub classics ranging from chicken wings to garlic prawns and calamari. The wine list draws heavily on nearby Okanagan producers including NK'Mip, Church & State, Moon Curser, and Hester Creek. The pub doubles as Osoyoos's home of UFC events, showing all fights with no cover charge.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is accessible and provides address (7603 Spartan Dr, Osoyoos, B.C.), phone (778-437-3838), and a full menu — all supplementing the sparse OSM record which has no address or phone. No mention anywhere of bike parking, bike racks, water refill, or washrooms; the menu shows food-heavy pub fare with some potentially vegetarian items but no explicit labels. The pub is clearly operating and in a prime Okanagan cycling corridor.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone; both were sourced solely from the website and cannot be cross-validated against OSM.
No bike-related infrastructure or cycling-friendly cues mentioned anywhere on the website.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The pub is a legitimate, operating food-and-drink destination in Osoyoos, a key Okanagan cycling corridor, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from the website. On-the-ground verification is needed before listing.
